subject: TruVue security questionnaire kickoff — clarify scope & timeline
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Evan Liu <evan.liu@truvuehealth.com>
Cc: Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@truvuehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: TruVue security questionnaire kickoff — clarify scope & timeline

Hi Evan / Sarah,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — really appreciated the context on how TruVue is using inference for triage and post-visit summarization. Per our call, the next step on our side is to kick off the vendor security questionnaire and confirm a few scope items so we route the right evidence. I captured the items below (short + actionable). If any of these need correction, call it out and we can adjust.

Quick recap / asks:
- Questionnaire: we typically complete either the SIG Lite or a CAIQ depending on your intake process. Which of those does your security team prefer? We can prefill parts of the SIG with our SOC 2 evidence to speed things up.
- PHI / HIPAA: Can you confirm whether TruVue will be sending PHI to Redwood (patient identifiers, clinical notes with PHI)? If yes, we will surface our BAA process and HIPAA scoping questions.
- Data residency: Do you require data to remain in US regions only?
- Timeline: What is your target response date for the questionnaire? Our typical turnaround for a prefilled SIG + evidence pack is ~7–10 business days depending on evidence gating.
- Technical POC: who on your side should we list as the technical contact for follow-up questions (API endpoints, sample payloads, IP allowlists)?

Attachments I’m including: our SOC 2 summary (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf) and a short encryption whitepaper. These should answer many of the common controls questions up front.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm preference (SIG vs CAIQ) and provide the intake contact.
2) We prefill the questionnaire and share a comments-enabled copy for your security team to review.
3) If you need a deeper controls walkthrough, we can schedule a 30-min security sync.

Would appreciate a note by EOD next Monday if that works for your procurement timeline.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (PDF, 180KB); redwood-encryption-whitepaper.pdf (PDF, 95KB)
From: Evan Liu <evan.liu@truvuehealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@truvuehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2026 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: TruVue security questionnaire kickoff — clarify scope & timeline

Hannah — thanks for the clear recap. A few quick answers from our side and one ask:

1) Questionnaire preference: Our security team prefers SIG Lite (vendor SIG) as the canonical intake. If you can prefill that it would be ideal. We also accept CAIQ but SIG is preferred.
2) PHI / HIPAA: Yes — TruVue processes PHI (identifiers + clinical notes). We will need a BAA in place before any production traffic.
3) Data residency: US-only (us-east & us-west) is required.
4) Timeline: We are aiming to complete vendor intake within three weeks to keep our integration on track.
5) Technical POC: looping in Sarah (procurement) as well as our platform lead (I’ll share contact details below).

I’m attaching an initial intake spreadsheet our security ops team uses (truvue-security-intake.xlsx) — it lists a few required artifacts and who on our side will review. If you could prefill the SIG Lite and return it with the SOC 2 evidence references, that will get us 90% of the way there.

One additional ask: our security org will want confirmation about where Redwood stores encryption keys (do you use customer-managed keys/KMS?) and whether logs containing request metadata are retained longer than 30 days by default. If you can pre-answer those two items in the prefill that will shorten review cycles.

Appreciate it — Evan
Evan Liu
Director, Platform Engineering — TruVue Health
evan.liu@truvuehealth.com | +1 (617) 555-0226

Attachment: truvue-security-intake.xlsx (XLSX, 28KB)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Evan Liu <evan.liu@truvuehealth.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2026 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: TruVue security questionnaire kickoff — clarify scope & timeline

Evan — great to meet you via thread. I’m the security engineer who will own the technical responses for the SIG prefill. Quick clarifying questions so we scope evidence correctly: 

1) PHI scope: can you confirm whether patient identifiers will be sent in the clear (e.g., name, MRN) or will TruVue tokenize/transform identifiers before sending? If identifiers are redacted/tokenized on your side that changes our recommended deployment patterns.
2) Deployment mode: will you be integrating with Redwood’s hosted API (Redwood-hosted inference) or planning an on-prem / Private VPC deployment? The evidence set (and BAA details) differ by mode.
3) Encryption keys: we support both Redwood-managed KMS keys and customer-managed keys (CMK) via cloud KMS — which do you require? If CMK is required we’ll note the KMS provider and key rotation policy in the prefill.
4) Logging & retention: our default retention for request metadata is 30 days; we can extend to 90/365 on dedicated/private contracts. Please confirm your retention requirement.

What I can commit to now (to speed your review):
- We will prefill SIG Lite with references to our SOC 2 controls and include links to the two attached PDFs (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, redwood-encryption-whitepaper.pdf).
- For HIPAA/BAA: we’ll include our standard BAA process overview and the expected timeline (BAA executed within ~5 business days once legal review is complete for customers on standard terms).

If you can answer 1–4 above and indicate whether hosted vs private deployment is planned, I’ll produce a prefilled SIG Lite (+ evidence matrix) by EOD next Wednesday. Also pasting a quick form link that helps us capture the technical POC / sample payloads so we don’t go back-and-forth: https://forms.gle/TruVueQuickScope

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Security Engineer — Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

Attachments referenced: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf; redwood-encryption-whitepaper.pdf
From: Evan Liu <evan.liu@truvuehealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@truvuehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: TruVue security questionnaire kickoff — clarify scope & timeline

Karthik — thanks, answered inline below and next steps: 

1) PHI scope: we will send full clinical notes including patient identifiers (name, DOB, MRN) to your hosted API for initial staging/testing. For production we are evaluating tokenization but cannot guarantee it during integration.
2) Deployment mode: we plan to use Redwood hosted inference (API) for initial integration, then evaluate Redwood Dedicated if throughput/latency requires.
3) Encryption keys: we require Redwood to support customer-managed keys (CMK) with AWS KMS.
4) Logging & retention: requirement is 90 days minimum for request metadata.

Timeline & next steps: we are aiming to complete the SIG + BAA within three weeks. Sarah (cc’d) is the procurement lead and will manage the legal review. Sarah — can we schedule a 30-min call Thursday 5/28 at 11am PT to review the prefilled SIG and next steps? I’m attaching our procurement contact card for ease.

I’ll complete the TruVueQuickScope form today and share any sample payloads we can provide.

Thanks — Evan

Attachment: truvue-procurement-contact.vcf (VCF)
